descriptions.d24c_input_post_20byte_800fa21c: Build a derived input record (base vtable 0x80410500, then 0x804104d0), push it on the vector at +172 of the 0x804aaf48 service when +428 is non-zero, else on +76, growing through 0x80212fd4 with fallback 0x803413d8 and freeing through 0x802134fc; then call the matching process function with the service and the record.
